description: Tianjin and Shenzhen snippets describe gatherings but do not establish a credible minimum of 50 participants.
required_followup: When admissible exact-URL body access is available, inspect contemporaneous reporting and seek independent, specific attendance evidence; do not convert “large numbers” into a count.

description: Xi’an Huacheng International entrance gathering and the reported police-station crowd may be one action moving between sites, separate actions, or a merged retelling.
required_followup: Compare full reports, original video chronology and named locations before merging or assigning separate events.

description: The Shenzhen action is dated 19 or 20 January across snippets and its site is variously called Shugang/Shugangang, Tianxin Village or Qingyun Garden.
required_followup: Resolve date and neighborhood from the original report and any first-hand contemporaneous documentation.

description: The Zhuhai and Liuzhou wage-action roundup entries lack accessible details on physical attendance, size, employer identity and whether a government body or policy was targeted.
required_followup: Identify the exact underlying incidents and check for a public gathering and an explicit own-state demand before applying inclusion criteria.

description: The Chongqing Jinke lead has a reported crowd above 100, but Jinke disputes the wage-arrears link; no own-state demand is established and account independence is unknown.
required_followup: Read both exact captured reports if available and distinguish participant action, alleged motive, corporate response and any state-directed demand.

description: All source cards currently rely on search-result discovery. RFA S001 exact-URL web.open timed out at the tool layer and same-URL HTTPS failed DNS before HTTP; NTD S005 web.open returned tool-side Cache miss and same-URL HTTPS failed DNS before HTTP. No publisher HTTP denial or article body was observed.
required_followup: Keep each source search-only unless a fresh allowed exact-URL access produces a readable body; distinguish tool/network failures from any publisher response and retain original-story/syndication relationships.

description: Xi’an lockdown and individual December encounters predate January; search results also mention a December 31 Shajing Village crowd whose protest status, size and continuation into January are unestablished. No confirmed protest episode beginning before January and continuing within January was identified.
required_followup: If reviewing neighboring-month units, verify whether any specific public protest began in December and continued after 1 January; do not treat a continuing lockdown alone as a protest continuation.

description: Response fields and protester violence remain unknown across most leads; reported detentions in snippets are not yet attributed to the same specific gatherings with confidence.
required_followup: Separate an antecedent detention from state action against a gathering; code only reported, incident-specific response evidence and leave silent fields unknown.

description: This first pass used open-web search and captured English and Chinese-language queries but has no systematic LexisNexis or equivalent press-archive access. Search-engine indexing, censorship, deleted posts and regional-media coverage limit recall; 23 captured search invocations do not establish exhaustive month coverage. A 2023 labor retrospective is used only to mark post-period chronology, not as January 2022 evidence.
required_followup: Coordinator review may direct further local/regional archive or independent source searches; absence from this search pass is not evidence that no event occurred.

description: Official baseline, original manual/version and applicable use conditions remain pending at the coordinator gate.
required_followup: Coordinator completes and records the official-baseline gate; worker candidates remain provisional and receive no official IDs.
